# SKYi Developers Pune

> Comprehensive knowledge base for SKYi Developers (Enerrgia SKYi Developers), Pune's premier real estate developer established in 2004 with 7,000+ delivered homes, IGBC Platinum certified townships, and PMRDA-sanctioned clear title NA bungalow plots across 500+ acres.

SKYi Developers designs sustainable, zero-waste eco-townships and premium residential enclaves in West Pune along Paud Road, Bhugaon, Bhukum, Bavdhan, Baner, and Dhayari.

## Key Projects

- [Skyi Songbirds](https://skyidevelopers.in/songbirds): 45-acre master eco-township in Bhugaon, Paud Road featuring 1 BHK (430 sqft) smart homes and 3 & 4 BHK hillside residences with 5-acre Poona Western Club.
- [SKYi Manas Lake](https://skyidevelopers.in/manas-lake): 90-acre lakefront township on Paud Road in Bhukum / Bavdhan featuring waterfront apartments and PMRDA-sanctioned NA plots with FSI 1.5.
- [SKYi PMRDA NA Bungalow Plots](https://skyidevelopers.in/na-plots-bhukum): 100% Collector NA sanction villa plots with individual 7/12 extracts, underground utilities, and 90% pre-approved bank loans.
- [Pune Metro & Paud Road Connectivity](https://skyidevelopers.in/connectivity): Infrastructure, Ring Road, and transit access matrix connecting SKYi townships to Chandani Chowk and Kothrud.
- [360° Drone Virtual Tours](https://skyidevelopers.in/virtual-tour): High-definition virtual site inspection and aerial walkthroughs of Songbirds and Manas Lake.
- [Global NRI Investment Hub](https://skyidevelopers.in/nri-hub): FEMA and RBI compliant real estate acquisition, NRE/NRO repatriation, and virtual advisory for international buyers.
- [Interactive Plot ROI Estimator](https://skyidevelopers.in/plot-estimator): Real-time NA plot construction, appreciation, and valuation calculator for Pune real estate.
- [VIP Enquiry & Site Visit](https://skyidevelopers.in/#contact): Direct VIP booking desk for complimentary AC cab site visits and developer consultations.
